name: high-utility-low-offense
category: pool with one high-utility low-offense mon
notes: Eleven functional attackers plus Shuckle: the canonical high-utility low-offense body (base 10 offenses, no evolution to rescue it). Utility roles are gated by the non-passive floor and weighted below attacker roles, so a support movepool must not bench a genuine threat. Under the usage-convergence blend (sole model since V0's retirement) Shuckle MAY take a marginal seat — its 3.03% shallow-tier webs usage earns a real α·O lift and the blend's earned drag collapses the empty-prior competition (Raticate 1340→670 at cap 25) — but the genuine threats must all still seat above it. The old mustNotSeat pin was V0-calibrated and is retired PENDING AN EXPLICIT RULING; see the V0-retirement changelog entry in SCORING.md. (Originally used Cottonee, but the evolution-requirements engine correctly legalized Sun-Stone Whimsicott — a real fast-utility mon — which is allowed to compete.)
